name: Sales Plan
current_rule_en: Wholesaler split of approved sales plan. Tooltip: Sales plan.  Total line comes from PB Sales Page, not editable.  HOC/CEO can split total wholesaler by wholesaler.  If total wholesaler data is not equal to total, it is RED and if equal to total – GREEN.  Show 0 for next year if no approved PB for next year. But it will cause incorrect calculation of PB deliveries. PB deliveries and PB Operation Plan logic should be connected to S&OP Main Page Shipment Forecast.
original_tr_note: distribütörler için elle giriş yapılıyor Totali Zone Sales Plandan geliyor distribütörlere paylaştırılıyor
inputs: Total from PB Sales Page / Zone Sales Plan; per-wholesaler split manual
outputs: Sales plan per wholesaler per month
formula_plain: Total = PB (budget) sales plan; Σ wholesaler split must = total
manual_override_role: HOC/CEO split per wholesaler; total not editable
colour_thresholds: Total row RED if Σ split ≠ total, GREEN if equal

name: GIT Forecast
current_rule_en: GIT forecast equals shipment forecast (display only). Tooltip: GIT Forecast.  Calculation: = Shipment forecast. Input disabled (ALL months). GIT Forecast for the past in not equal to GIT Actual.   LEAD TIME LOGIC is not used
original_tr_note: Shipment Actual ya da shipment forecast ve shipment plandan veri gelir o ayda belirlenen shipment plan varsa o yoksa shipment forecast gelir.
inputs: Shipment Plan (if exists in month) else Shipment Forecast; Shipment Actual for past (TR note)
formula_plain: GIT_FC(m) = ShipmentPlan(m) if present else ShipmentForecast(m); past GIT_FC ≠ GIT_Actual

name: GIT Actual
current_rule_en: GIT actual from wholesaler out-invoices by invoice date. Tooltip: GIT Actual.  Show total for each product for this month from all UNAPPROVED Out Invoices (Buyer = wholesaler, invoice date = month). Data is taken from Wholesaler GIT page.  Input disabled (ALL months).   LEAD TIME LOGIC is not used.
original_tr_note: Good In Transit (GIT Invoices) sayfasında onaylanmış Normal Out invoice tipindeki faturalar invoice tarihine göre gelmektedir
inputs: Out invoices, buyer = wholesaler (Wholesaler GIT page)
outputs: GIT actual per product per month
formula_plain: GIT_ACT(m) = Σ qty of out-invoices with invoice date in m — tooltip says UNAPPROVED, TR note says approved (OQ)

name: Sell In Forecast
current_rule_en: Sell-in forecast = shipment shifted by CWH→WS lead time. Tooltip: Sell In Forecast  Calculation: Shipment Forecast for (Analyzed Month - Lead time).  LEAD TIME LOGIC:  (1) Lead time = Lead time from CWH to WS (Analyzed Year-1) if Analyzed Month - Lead time from CWH to WS (Analyzed Year) <= 0;  (2) Lead time = Lead time from CWH to WS (Analyzed Year) if Analyzed Month - Lead time from CWH to WS (Analyzed Year) > 0.  Input disabled (ALL months). Sell In Forecast is updated dynamically when Shipment Forecast is updated.
original_tr_note: //eğer lead time kadar gerisinde sell in actual data zaten varsa aynı data sell in forecast sıfırlanır //lead time kadar gerisinde actual varsa actual eşit olacak //lead time kadar gerisinde actual yoksa shipment plan  varsa plana eşit olacak //lead time kadar gerisinde actual ve plan yoksa forecasta eşit olacak
inputs: Shipment forecast/plan/actual; lead time CWH→WS per year
formula_plain: SI_FC(m) = SI_ACT(m−LT) if exists else ShipPlan(m−LT) if exists else ShipFC(m−LT); LT taken from previous year's setting when m−LT ≤ 0
lead_time_logic: CWH→WS lead time; year-boundary rule uses LT of analysed year−1
manual_override_role: input disabled; recalculated when shipment forecast changes

name: Sell In Actual
current_rule_en: Sell-in actual from approved out-invoices by approval date. Tooltip: Sell In Actual.  Show total for each product for this month from all APPROVED Out Invoices (Buyer = wholesaler, APPROVAL date = month). Data is taken from Wholesaler GIT page.  CREDIT NOTE request can be created for all approved invoices which have UNPAID invoice amount).  Input disabled (ALL months).  LEAD TIME LOGIC is not used.
original_tr_note: Good In Transit (GIT Invoices) sayfasında onaylanmış Normal Out invoice tipindeki faturalar good in transit tarihine göre gelmektedir
inputs: Approved out invoices, buyer = wholesaler; credit-note eligibility
outputs: Sell-in actual per product per month
formula_plain: SI_ACT(m) = Σ qty approved out-invoices with approval date in m (TR note: by goods-in-transit date — OQ)
manual_override_role: input disabled; HOC may raise credit-note request on approved unpaid invoices

name: Special Cases (Samples and Expired)
current_rule_en: Special cases (damaged, samples, expired) via approved credit notes. Tooltip: Special cases.  Credit Note should be taken for Special Cases Line. Credit note + reason=damaged, samples or expired. HOC create Credit Note Request in GIT page.  Approved Credit Note data influence (minus) Wholesaler Stock Forecast.  Input disabled (ALL months).
original_tr_note: Credit Note tan geliyor
inputs: Approved credit notes with reason damaged/samples/expired
formula_plain: SPEC(m) = Σ approved credit-note qty (reason ∈ damaged, samples, expired) in m
manual_override_role: HOC creates credit-note request on GIT page; input disabled

name: Wholesaler Stock Forecast
current_rule_en: Wholesaler stock forecast roll-forward. Tooltip: Wholesaler Stock Forecast.  Calculation (CURRENT + FUTURE): Wholesaler Stock Forecast (analyzed month-1) + Sell In Forecast (analyzed month) - Special Cases (analyzed month) - Sell Out Forecast (analyzed month).  Calculation (PAST): = Wholesaler Stock Actual.  DO not plus Sell In Forecast if these goods already in Sell In Actual (PLUS Sell in Forecast ONLY IF GIT invoices are approved in CURRENT month or NOT approved).  Wholesaler line highlighting:  Wholesaler Stock Forecast Total line: RED if < 0  If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page == 0  1. Wholesaler Stock FC: RED if Stock Level FC <= 1   2. Wholesaler Stock FC: yellow if Stock Level FC >1<3  3. Wholesaler Stock FC: fields green if Stock Level FC=>3  Else If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page > 0 and Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page <99  1. Wholesaler Stock FC: RED if Stock Level FC <= Min distributor stock  2. Wholesaler Stock FC: GREEN if Stock Level FC > Min distributor stock  Else If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page equal 99  1. Wholesaler Stock FC: WHITE
original_tr_note: geçmiş aydaki wholesaler stock actual + eğer analiz edilen ayda sell in actual var ise o eklenir yok ise analiz edilen ayda ki sell in forecat - special cases - sell out forecast
inputs: Previous stock, sell-in forecast/actual, special cases, sell-out forecast, min distributor stock (LEAD TIME page)
formula_plain: Past: WS_FC = WS_ACT. Current/future: WS_FC(m) = WS_FC(m−1) + SI(m) − SPEC(m) − SO_FC(m), where SI(m) = SI_ACT(m) if invoices already approved, else SI_FC(m) (only if GIT approved in current month or not approved)
colour_thresholds: Total RED if <0. If MinDistStock=0: RED ≤1, YELLOW >1 and <3, GREEN ≥3 (months). If 0<MinDistStock<99: RED ≤ MinDistStock, GREEN > MinDistStock. If MinDistStock=99: WHITE

name: Stock Level Forecast, months
current_rule_en: Months of supply at wholesaler. Tooltip: Stock Level Forecast   Calculation: Wholesaler Stock Forecast / Sell Out Forecast. If Sell Out Forecast equal to 0 THEN Stock Level Forecast = 99. Max show limit 99.  Stock Level Forecast highlighting:  RED if less than monthly min wholesaler stock.  If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page == 0  1. Stock Level FC: RED if  Stock Level FC <= 1   2. Stock Level FC: yellow if Stock Level FC >1<3  3. Stock Level FC: green if Stock Level FC=>3  Else If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page > 0 and Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page <99  1. Stock Level FC: RED if Stock Level FC <= Min distributor stock  2. Stock Level FC: GREEN if Stock Level FC > Min distributor stock  Else If Min distributor stock, month from LEAD TIME page equal 99  1. Wholesaler Stock FC and Stock Level FC fields WHITE
formula_plain: MOS(m) = WS_FC(m) / SO_FC(m); if SO_FC(m)=0 → 99; display capped at 99

name: Wholesaler Stock Actual/Forecast
current_rule_en: Wholesaler stock actual (editable). Tooltip: Wholesaler Stocks Actual.  Data from Table stocks of Wholesaler Stock Actual.  Previous, current and future months are enable for input (HOC+CEO).  Red if empty (0) for past months.  Actual Sales are calculated based on Wholesaler Actual Stock.
original_tr_note: Actual a wholesaler stok / forecast : geçmiş aydaki wholesaler stock actual + eğer analiz edilen ayda sell in actual var ise o eklenir yok ise analiz edilen ayda ki sell in forecat - special cases - sell out forecast
formula_plain: WS_ACT(m) from table; HOC+CEO may input past, current and future months; actual sales derived from it
manual_override_role: HOC+CEO input for past/current/future (OQ: editing actuals)
colour_thresholds: RED if empty (0) in past months

name: Sell Out Actual/Forecast
current_rule_en: Sell-out forecast (manual) / actual (past). Tooltip: Sell Out Forecast   Calculation (PAST): = Sell Out Actual  Calculation (CURRENT&FUTURE): Manual input  Sell out Forecast lines highlighting:   1. green if sell out => Sales Plan  2. red if sell out < Sales Plan  Sell Out Actual and Sell Out Forecast lines should be 0 (Zero) for December-2016  Sell Out Forecast should have RED BACKGROUND if not registered until Reg. start date + Reg. LEAD TIME
original_tr_note: Sell Out Forecast elle giriliyor . Sell Out Actual kısmı wholesaler stock verileri geliyor(eğer sellout forecast stock actualdan büyük ise)
inputs: Manual input; sales plan; registration start + reg lead time
formula_plain: Past: SO_FC = SO_ACT; current/future: manual
lead_time_logic: registration lead time for red background
colour_thresholds: GREEN if sell-out ≥ sales plan; RED if < sales plan; RED background if not registered by reg. start date + reg. lead time. Dec-2016 forced 0

name: Sell Out Actual
current_rule_en: Sell-out actual derived from stock movement. Tooltip: Sell Out Actual  Calculation (PAST):  Wholesaler Stock Actual(Previous Month) - Wholesaler Stock(Current Month) + Sell In Actual(Current Month) - Special Cases(Current Month)  Calculation (CURRENT+FUTURE): Input Disabled  Sell out Actual lines highlighting:   1. green if sell out => Sales Plan  2. red if sell out < Sales Plan
original_tr_note: Sell Out Actual kısmı wholesaler stock verileri geliyor(eğer sellout forecast stock actualdan büyük ise)
inputs: WS stock actual (m−1, m), sell-in actual, special cases
formula_plain: SO_ACT(m) = WS_ACT(m−1) − WS_ACT(m) + SI_ACT(m) − SPEC(m) (past only)
colour_thresholds: GREEN ≥ sales plan; RED < sales plan

name: Shipment Needs
current_rule_en: Shipment needs (empty in source). Tooltip:
formula_plain: NOT FOUND — tooltip empty

name: Shipment Forecast
current_rule_en: Shipment forecast with remaining-forecast roll-over. Tooltip: Shipment Forecast.  Manual input by HOC/CEO.  Shipment forecast (PAST): Shipment Actual.  Passed months closed.  Calculation of previous month remaining Shipment forecast: Current month Shipment forecasts = Current month Shipment forecasts + Previous month Shipment forecasts – Previous Month Shipment Actual. If remaining Shipment forecast < 0 THEN Current month Shipment forecasts = 0  Shipment Forecast wholesaler field highlighting:  1. GREEN if Shipment forecast total for all Wholesales <= Central WH stock forecast  2. RED if Shipment forecast total for all Wholesales > Central WH stock forecast
original_tr_note: analiz edilen ayda bulunun actual kontrolü. eğer varsa shipment forecast 0 olur. yoksa hesaplanır Eğer sonraki sevkiyat mevcutsa: Sell-Out Forecast Hesaplanıyor (Mevcut analiz edilen ay ile sonraki sevkiyat arasındaki tahmini satış çıkışı toplamı) Eğer geçmiş wholesaler stock + sell-in actual data - sell-out forecast (Mevcut analiz edilen ay ile sonraki sevkiyat arasındaki tahmini satış çıkışı toplamı)  negatif çıkıyorsa, yeni sevkiyat ihtiyacı olmadığı anlamına geliyor Eğer gelecekte hiç satış tahmini yoksa, sevkiyat iptal ediliyor   Başlangıç ve Bitiş Tarihleri: Kod, belirli tarihler arasında, yani geçmiş ve gelecekteki sevkiyatlar arasında hesaplamalar yapıyor. Bu tarihler, bir "lead time" (önceden belirlenen zaman aralığı) eklenerek hesaplanıyor. Örneğin, startDate ve endDate, önceden belirlenmiş "lead time" eklenerek hesaplanıyor. Geçmiş veriler (örneğin, geçmiş toptancı verisi) ve mevcut stok seviyeleri (obligatorystock) dikkate alınarak, ne kadar ürün sevk edilmesi gerektiği hesaplanır. Eğer bu veriler yeterliyse, sevkiyat miktarı hesaplanır. Koşullara Göre Sevkiyat Miktarının Ayarlanması:  Eğer geçmiş veriler ve stoklar belirli bir eşiği geçiyorsa (örneğin, geçmiş veriler artı stoklar belirli bir miktarın üzerinde), sevkiyat miktarı belirlenir. Eğer mevcut veriler yeterli değilse, sevkiyat miktarı sıfırlanır. Ayrıca, bazı durumlarda bu hesaplama, gelecek tarihlerdeki satış tahminlerini de dikkate alarak, gelecekteki sevkiyatları da tahmin etmeye çalışır.
inputs: Manual input HOC/CEO; shipment actual; CWH stock forecast; TR note describes need calc from sell-out until next shipment
outputs: Shipment forecast per wholesaler per month
formula_plain: Past = shipment actual (closed). Current: ShipFC(m) = ShipFC(m) + ShipFC(m−1) − ShipACT(m−1), floored at 0. TR note: if actual exists in m → 0; need = Σ SO_FC(m..next shipment) − (WS stock + SI actual); negative → no shipment; no future sales forecast → shipment cancelled
lead_time_logic: start/end window = shipment dates shifted by lead time (TR note)
colour_thresholds: GREEN if Σ wholesalers ≤ CWH stock forecast; RED if >

name: Shipment Plan
current_rule_en: Shipment plan from proforma invoices. Tooltip: Shipment Plan.  Calculation: Take data from proforma OUT invoice (Buyer = the selected company (RO or affiliated company)).  Input Disabled.   Shipment plan wholesaler highlighting:   1. green if  Shipment plan total for all Wholesales <= Central WH stock actual (reserved+non reserved)  2. red if Shipment plan total for all Wholesales > Central WH stock actual (reserved+non reserved)  TODO: Shipment Plan + Shipment Forecast should be closed if Registration Main Dosage equal to Expired and NO Re-registration or registration , In progress.
original_tr_note: Proforma faturalar invoice tarihine göre alınır
inputs: Proforma OUT invoices (buyer = selected company RO/affiliate) by invoice date
formula_plain: ShipPlan(m) = Σ proforma out-invoice qty in m
colour_thresholds: GREEN if Σ wholesalers ≤ CWH stock actual (reserved+non-reserved); RED if >. TODO: close plan+forecast when registration expired and no re-registration in progress

name: Shipment Actual/Forecast
current_rule_en: Shipment actual from out-invoices; shipment forecast need formula. Tooltip: Shipment Actual.  Data come from Out Invoices for all batches for the selected product for each wholesaler.  Input Disabled.  No lead time used.    Shipment Forecast:  [(Take according to lead time)(Sell Out Actual/Forecast +  Wholesaler Obligatory Stock +  Wholesaler Safety Stock)-( Wholesaler Stock Actual/Forecast)    For the shipment period ;  If there's no sales forecast , do not calculate extra shipment for obligatory+safety stock
original_tr_note: Shipment Actual (Gitte approve olmuş out invoicelar invoice tarihine göre gelir)
inputs: Out invoices all batches per wholesaler; sell-out, obligatory stock, safety stock, WS stock
formula_plain: ShipACT(m) = Σ approved out-invoice qty (invoice date). ShipFC need = Σ over shipment period [SO(t) + OBL + SS] − WS_stock; if no sales forecast in period → no extra OBL+SS
lead_time_logic: take according to lead time (window not defined — OQ)

name: Warehouse Stock Forecast
current_rule_en: Central/affiliate warehouse stock projection with production supply. Tooltip: Warehouse Stock Forecast.  Calculation (PAST): Warehouse Stock (Rezerveded) + Warehouse Stock (Non-Rezerveded). For each AF WH show total batches for the selected LSKU (GSKU+AC Country).  Calculation (CURRENT + FUTURE):   LEAD TIME LOGIC:  TEMP_YEAR (MAIN DESCRIPTION):  (1) TEMP_YEAR1 = Analyzed Year-1 if Analyzed Month - LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year) <= 0;  (2) TEMP_YEAR1 = Analyzed Year if Analyzed Month - LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year) > 0;  (1) TEMP_YEAR2 = Analyzed Year-1 if Analyzed Month - LT-P(Analyzed Year) - LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year) <= 0;  (2) TEMP_YEAR2 = Analyzed Year if Analyzed Month - LT-P(Analyzed Year) - LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year) > 0;    Warehouse Stock Forecast(analyzed month-1) + (IF Production Actual != 0 AND THEN Production Actual(analyzed month - LT-F-CW(TEMP_YEAR1)) for ALL countries for the selected LSKU ELSE(Production Actual == 0) IF analyzed month  - LT-P - LT-F-CW ( for analyzed year) OR analyzed month +12 - LT-P - LT-F-CW ( for analyzed year+1)  < current month THEN Production Order(analyzed month - LT-P(TEMP_YEAR2) - LT-F-CW(TEMP_YEAR2)) for ALL countries for the selected LSKU ELSE Production Forecast(analyzed month - LT-P(TEMP_YEAR2) - LT-F-CW(TEMP_YEAR2)) for ALL countries for the selected LSKU ) - Shipment Forecast for ALL countries for the selected LSKU(analyzed month).  Highlighting: RED IF < 0.    TODO: ===>  RESTRICTION:  IF Analyzed month > LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year-1) AND Analyzed month <= LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year)  THEN  DO NOT CALCULATE Production Actual    IF Analyzed month > LT-P(Analyzed Year-1) + LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year-1) AND Analyzed month <= LT-P(Analyzed Year) + LT-F-CW(Analyzed Year)  THEN  DO NOT CALCULATE Production Order&Production Forecast  <===
original_tr_note: SKU PRODUCTION SETTINGS sayfasından Production Lead Time ve FACTORY-CWH LEAD TIME, DAYS verileri getirilir analiz edilen aydan bunlar kadar geriye gidilerek duruma göre production actual , order ya da forecast verisine geçmiş aydaki warehouse stock verisi eklenir ve shipment forecast çıkarılır
inputs: Reserved+non-reserved stock; production actual/order/forecast; LT-P, LT-F-CW per year; shipment forecast (all countries, LSKU)
formula_plain: Past: WS = reserved + non-reserved. Current/future: WHS_FC(m) = WHS_FC(m−1) + Supply − ShipFC_allCountries(m); Supply = ProdACT(m−LT_FCW) if ≠0, else ProdOrder(m−LT_P−LT_FCW) if that month < current month, else ProdFC(m−LT_P−LT_FCW); year chosen by TEMP_YEAR rules; TODO restrictions not to count supply inside the lead-time window

name: Warehouse Stock (Rezerved)
current_rule_en: Reserved warehouse stock by country. Tooltip: Warehouse Stock (Reserved).  Calculation: Show total batches for each AF WH for the selected LSKU (GSKU+AC Country) reserved for AC Country for all wholesalers.  IMPORTANT: Total line calculation should use formula similar to line calculation (NOT sum of sublevel lines).
original_tr_note: Geçmiş aylar için ülkeye rezerve edilmiş olan veriler gelecekte ise production order ya da production forecast verileri
inputs: Batches per AF WH reserved for AC country
formula_plain: Σ batches reserved for country; total row uses the line formula, not sum of sublines; future months = production order/forecast (TR note)

name: Warehouse Stock (Non Rezerved)
current_rule_en: Non-reserved warehouse stock. Tooltip: Warehouse Stock (Non-Reserved).  Calculation: Show total batches for each AF WH for the selected LSKU (GSKU+AC Country) with non-reserved status. Show only suitable for this country LSKU.  IMPORTANT: Total line calculation should use formula similar to line calculation (NOT sum of sublevel lines).
original_tr_note: warehousetaki tüm ülkeye ve contractor company e rezerve edilmiş stokların toplamı
inputs: Batches per AF WH non-reserved, suitable LSKU
formula_plain: Σ non-reserved batches suitable for country LSKU; total row uses line formula; TR note: sum reserved to country and contractor company (contradiction — OQ)

name: Production Needs
current_rule_en: Production needs (version 1). Tooltip: Production Needs.  Calculation:  IF Shipment Forecast for month = (Current + Lead time Production + Lead time from Factory to Central Warehouse ) >  Central Warehouse Stock Forecast  THEN Shipment Forecast minus Central Warehouse Stock Forecast both for calculated month (see above)  IF Shipment Forecast for month = (Current + Lead time Production + Lead time from Factory to Central Warehouse ) <=  Central Warehouse Stock Forecast  THEN 0
inputs: Shipment forecast at month m+LT_P+LT_FCW; CWH stock forecast
formula_plain: If ShipFC(m*) > WHS_FC(m*) with m* = current + LT_P + LT_FCW → need = ShipFC − WHS_FC else 0

name: Order Forecast
current_rule_en: Order (production) forecast manual with roll-over. Tooltip: Production Forecast.  Manually by CEO.  Calculation of previous month remaining forecast: Current month Production forecasts = Current month Production forecasts + Previous month Production forecasts – Previous Month Production Order. If remaining Production forecast < 0 THEN Current month Production forecasts = 0  Production Forecast goes to Production Adjustment page.  Production Forecast is updated from Production Adjustment page.  Production Forecast can be updated after Production Adjustment update.
original_tr_note: Manuel girilmiş veriler sell out forecast production order verileri toplamı
formula_plain: ProdFC(m) = ProdFC(m) + ProdFC(m−1) − ProdOrder(m−1), floored at 0; feeds Production Adjustment page and is updated from it

name: Order Actual
current_rule_en: Order actual = approved production orders. Tooltip: Production Order.  Data comes from Production Order History after approval.  Input Disabled.  No lead time logic.
original_tr_note: Production Order verileri
formula_plain: ProdOrder(m) = Σ approved production orders

name: Production Actual/Preliminary
current_rule_en: Production actual from batch creation. Tooltip: Production Actual.  Data is taken automatically from Batch Creation: Local SKU + Total for All Batches + Batch Production Date (Month + Year). The batch list of all local SKUs connected  to these brands  in the country, sum of the quantity to manufacture date.  Production Actual lines should be disable for ALL months.
original_tr_note: (Analiz edilen ayda üretilen batch quantity * batchlerin üretildiği orderın o ülkeye order miktarı) / toplam order adeti
inputs: Batch creation: LSKU, batch qty, production date
formula_plain: ProdACT(m) = Σ batch qty with production month m for LSKUs of the brand in the country; TR note: allocate batch qty × country order qty / total order qty

name: Wholesaler Obligatory Stock
current_rule_en: Wholesaler obligatory stock. Tooltip: S&OP main page new line (monthly): Lead time (days) x Average Daily SALES (last 6 months the presence of a product, if last 6 month comes 0 take next 6 month)  Obligatory stock = Sell Out Actual ({current month -1, current month -7})/6/30*(LEAD TIMES Average (Negotiation with distributors + Preparing custom documents + GIT + Lab analyzes time)
original_tr_note: Önce, belirli SKU’lar ve distribütörler için satış tahmini (forecast) verileri ve gerçekleşmiş satış (actual) verileri alınıyor. Bu iki veri birleştirilerek, geçmiş satış performansı hakkında bir genel tablo oluşturuluyor. Shipment settings sayfasından (git_avg = t.git_avg + t.DeliverySetting.custom_doc_avg + t.DeliverySetting.lab_avg + t.DeliverySetting.negotiation_avg,git_max = t.git_max + t.DeliverySetting.custom_doc_max + t.DeliverySetting.lab_max + t.DeliverySetting.negotiation_max,) ı alıyor Son 6 ay içindeki toplam satış miktarı bulunuyor. Bulunan toplam satış miktarı, günlük satış ortalamasına çevriliyor.(obStock = (sellOutData / (n * 30)) * item.git_avg;)
inputs: Sell-out actual last 6 months (fallback next 6), lead-time averages (negotiation, custom docs, GIT, lab)
formula_plain: OBL = Σ SO_ACT(m−1..m−6)/6/30 × (avg negotiation + avg custom docs + avg GIT + avg lab) days
lead_time_logic: average lead times from Shipment settings

name: Wholesaler Safety Stock
current_rule_en: Wholesaler safety stock. Tooltip: Safety stock = Sell Out Actual ({current month -1, current month -1-N})/N/30*(LEAD TIMES MAXIMUM (Negotiation with distributors + Preparing custom documents + GIT + Lab analyzes time) - Obligatory stock  N=6
original_tr_note: Maksimum teslimat süresi kullanılarak, bir güvenlik stoğu hesaplanıyor. Bulunan maksimum zorunlu stoktan, normal zorunlu stok çıkarılarak ekstra tutulması gereken güvenlik stoğu belirleniyor.decimal safeStock = (((sellOutData / (n * 30)) * item.git_max) - obStock);
inputs: Sell-out actual last N=6 months, max lead times
formula_plain: SS = Σ SO_ACT(m−1..m−N)/N/30 × (max negotiation + max custom docs + max GIT + max lab) − OBL; N=6

name: MAIN WH Stock Actual/Forecast
current_rule_en: Main warehouse stock actual/forecast. Tooltip: PAST  Reserved + Non-Reserved stocks for all warehouses  CURRENT MONTH  Manufacturer Warehouse Current Reserved Stock - Production Actual (Anlyzed Month - Lead Time) + Production Actual (Analyzed Month) Mainwarehouse Laststock Current Reserved Stock - Shipment Forecast + Production Actual (Anlyzed Month - Lead Time)  FUTURE  Manufacturer Warehouse Last month stock - Production Actual (Anlyzed Month - Lead Time) + Production Actual (Analyzed Month) Mainwarehouse Laststock Last month stock - Shipment Forecast + Production Actual (Anlyzed Month - Lead Time)
inputs: Manufacturer WH reserved stock, production actual, main WH last stock, shipment forecast
formula_plain: Past: reserved + non-reserved all WH. Current: MfrWH = MfrWH_reserved − ProdACT(m−LT) + ProdACT(m); MainWH = MainWH_last − ShipFC + ProdACT(m−LT). Future: same with last-month stock

name: Production Needs
current_rule_en: Production needs (version 2). Tooltip: If Analyzed Month MW Stock is negative, production is needed. Show the necessary amount before Production Lead Time - Analyzed Month
original_tr_note: analiz edilen ay - lead timelar bulunduğumuz aydan büyük ise warehouse stock forecast - ise eksik olan miktar analiz edilen ay + lead time(factory cwhs ) ayında gösterilir
formula_plain: If MW_FC(m) < 0 → need |MW_FC(m)| shown at month (m − LT_P); TR note: shown at m + LT(factory→CWH) — contradiction

name: Order Needs
current_rule_en: Order needs. Tooltip: If Analyzed Month MW Stock is negative, production is needed. For production , an order is needed. Show the necessary amount before (Factory->MW leadtime + Production Lead Time ) - Analyzed Month
original_tr_note: analiz edilen ay - lead timelar bulunduğumuz aydan büyük ise warehouse stock forecast - ise eksik olan miktar analiz edilen analiz edilen ay - lead time ayında gösterilir
formula_plain: If MW_FC(m) < 0 → need shown at month m − (LT_FCW + LT_P)

name: Relocation
current_rule_en: Relocation between wholesalers. Tooltip:
original_tr_note: Wholesaler Stok Management sayfasındaki Relocation satırındaki verilerin toplamı gelir

formula_plain: Relocation(m) = Σ relocation entries (effect on WS stock not stated — OQ)

name: Order forecast lot-sized to minimum batch
current_rule_en: Order forecast = shipment forecast minus MW stock, rounded up to whole production batches
original_tr_note: F12: 'take the shipment forecast … roundup by batch size'
inputs: Shipment forecast (M10), MW stock (L11), min batch (G38)
formula_plain: ORDER_FC = ROUNDUP((ShipFC(t) − MW_stock(t−1)) / MinBatch, 0) × MinBatch
lead_time_logic: order month = shipment month − total lead time (see AO-02)

name: Total lead time in months
current_rule_en: Lead-time components summed and converted to months (negative offset)
inputs: Negotiation 10, custom docs 10, lab 10, penetration 20, CWH→WS 20, factory→CWH 20, production 90, CWH obligatory 30 (days)
formula_plain: LT_months = −Σ(days)/30 = −210/30 = −7
lead_time_logic: sum of all components incl. 'PENETRATION' and 'CWH OBLIGATORY' (OQ)

name: Take the highest distributor limit
current_rule_en: Use the MAX of all distributors' limits
original_tr_note: H21: 'take higher one from MAX from all distributors limites'

name: Projected average inventory (months)
current_rule_en: Months of stock = warehouse stock / average sales forecast
original_tr_note: O9: 'Kaç aylık stok olduğu hesaplanacak … WH Stock / AVG Sales Forecast'
formula_plain: MOC = WH_stock / AVG(sales forecast) (window NOT FOUND)

current_rule_en: Stock status = wholesaler stocks + CWH reserved + PS reserved, reduced by forecast of other countries using the same product
